package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	data, _ := os.ReadFile("/dev/stdin")
	f := strings.Fields(string(data))
	p := 0
	t, _ := strconv.Atoi(f[p])
	p++
	out := make([]string, 0, t)
	for g := 0; g < t; g++ {
		n, _ := strconv.Atoi(f[p])
		p++
		sum := 0
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			v, _ := strconv.Atoi(f[p])
			p++
			sum += v
		}
		out = append(out, strconv.Itoa(sum))
	}
	fmt.Println(strings.Join(out, "\n"))
}
